description:
Create a technical electrical layout for the kitchen area of the default 'Sample House' project using the 2D Blueprint view.

Actions required:
1. Switch the view to '2D Blueprint' mode.
2. Navigate to the kitchen area (look for the refrigerator, sink, and stove).
3. Using the 'Add Symbols' tool (often found under the 2D or Tools tab), place the following electrical symbols in the kitchen:
   - 4x Standard Outlets (place along walls/counters)
   - 1x Light Switch (place near the entrance/doorway)
   - 1x High Voltage Outlet (place behind/near the stove)
4. Ensure the symbols are clearly visible in the blueprint view.
5. Save a screenshot of the kitchen blueprint showing these symbols to 'C:\Users\Docker\Documents\kitchen_electrical_plan.png'.
6. Save the project to preserve changes.
